primary_intent: Ensure that a single Appointment exists for patient Tomasz Wren (DOB 1966-01-30) with practitioner Dr Ama Osei on 2026-11-17 from 14:00Z to 14:30Z, status booked, with exactly two participants (patient and practitioner) each accepted—creating it if absent, or reporting it if already present. A reasonable user would be inflexible about the correct patient, practitioner, date/time, status, and participant statuses, and about not creating duplicates.
reasoning: Nitpicks: (1) No on-screen visual confirmation of the Practitioner record; (2) Duplicate-check evidence was light (the agent reports the list flickered and relied on a glimpse); (3) No screenshot of the saved Appointment detail page. These reduce confidence but do not by themselves prove an incorrect outcome. Critical issues: None are evidenced—there is no visual contradiction that the wrong patient/practitioner, time window, or participant statuses were used, nor evidence of duplicate creation. Critical-Point decision: The task required crossing a CP (creating/saving the Appointment). The applicable rule is SUCCESS: agent crossed the CP and completed the binding action correctly using provided information. The action history shows the agent created an Appointment via the JSON editor with the exact required fields: status=booked; start=2026-11-17T14:00:00Z; end=2026-11-17T14:30:00Z; participants for Patient/fb92e... (Tomasz Wren) and Practitioner/7956... (display “Dr Ama Osei”), both with status=accepted, then returned a concrete resource id (Appointment/18250f2e-7adf-4298-817b-9c41fdf258b7). Screenshots confirm the correct patient record exists. While there is no direct screenshot of the practitioner or the created appointment, nothing contradicts the agent’s claims, and the final RESULT line provides the created record reference. The user’s primary intent—having exactly one correctly specified appointment booked—appears satisfied based on the created resource details and absence of evidence of duplicates.

items.criterion: Create the Appointment exactly as specified
items.condition: Only applies if no matching Appointment already exists
items.description: Create and save a single FHIR Appointment resource with: status=booked; start=2026-11-17T14:00:00Z; end=2026-11-17T14:30:00Z; exactly two participants: (1) Patient Tomasz Wren with participant.status=accepted and (2) Practitioner Dr Ama Osei with participant.status=accepted; no extras. Full credit if all fields match and exactly one Appointment is created. Full credit also if creation is not possible due to external constraints (e.g., Medplum unavailable, insufficient permissions, validator errors, or missing Patient/Practitioner after reasonable search) and this limitation is clearly reported after an attempt to create. Partial credit for minor omissions (e.g., correct time and participants but one participant status not set to accepted) if corrected prior to final save, or for preparing the correct resource but being blocked at save while clearly reporting the issue. No credit if key attributes are wrong, multiple appointments are created, or the agent stops short of saving without any external blocking reason.
items.justification: The agent created and saved an Appointment via the JSON editor with status 'booked', start '2026-11-17T14:00:00Z', end '2026-11-17T14:30:00Z', and exactly two participants (Patient and Practitioner), each with participant.status 'accepted'. A new Appointment id (Appointment/18250f2e-...) was produced, indicating a successful save.
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshots do not show the created Appointment, but the action history shows entering and saving an Appointment JSON with status 'booked', the specified start/end, and exactly two accepted participants (Patient fb92e363-..., Practitioner 7956ce69-...). The predicted output includes an Appointment ID.
items.post_image_justification: No screenshot contradiction exists; action history supports successful creation exactly as specified. Full credit.

items.criterion: Provide final RESULT line with the correct record reference

Full credit if format and content are correct and consistent with the actual outcome. Partial credit if minor formatting errors occur but the id/URL and outcome are still clear.
items.justification: The final output ends with 'RESULT: DONE Appointment/18250f2e-7adf-4298-817b-9c41fdf258b7' in the correct format, consistent with the created record.
items.applicable_evidence: The agent’s predicted output ends with 'RESULT: DONE Appointment/18250f2e-7adf-4298-817b-9c41fdf258b7'.
